title: Every test/fork file changed in Phase 22 has not executed under the real fork project
severity_rationale: S2 by the plan: an unrun change can hide a fork-mode break.

evidence.note: 11 files: test/fork/antiRugDetector.fork.test.ts, test/fork/captureRehearsal.fork.test.ts, test/fork/deliberateBuyReplay.fork.test.ts, test/fork/exitStatePersistence.fork.test.ts, test/fork/helpers/forkRpcUrl.ts, test/fork/helpers/hardhatChildEnv.ts, test/fork/honeypotChecker.fork.test.ts, test/fork/honeypotDeploy.eth.fork.test.ts, test/fork/rails/forkRails.fork.test.ts, test/fork/realLaunchReplay.fork.test.ts, test/fork/setup.ts

sibling_sites_checked: The fork project needs Hardhat, which Phase 22 may not start (AC-08). The rail assertions among these files are UFV-01 to UFV-05; the others are mechanical edits recorded in AUD-TESTQ-011 to AUD-TESTQ-016.
escaped_regression: A fork test broken by these edits (a missing import, a wrong argument order, a resolver that throws under the real project) would stay green until Phase 25 first runs the fork suite.
recommendation: Run the whole fork suite at the first npm run test:fork of v7.0, owner Phase 25, and record the pass or fail of each file.
